groups.label: feature-392
groups.message:
feat(#392): parallel completion policies — discriminator, race, quorum-continue

Extend parallel: with advance-after and cancel-remaining options to
support four completion policies on the same execution substrate:
- parallel (wait-all, default, unchanged)
- discriminator (advance-after: N, cancel-remaining: false)
- race (advance-after: 1, cancel-remaining: true)
- quorum-continue (advance-after: N, cancel-remaining: false)

Implementation:
- ParallelStep record gains advanceAfter, cancelRemaining, collectionTimeout
- ParallelCompletionTracker (two-latch pattern, analogous to QuorumTracker)
- Walker polymorphic parsing (list and map forms)
- Dual-path evaluator (executor for default, SpawnedTask for policy)
- StepSchemaComposer oneOf for polymorphic parallel schema
- Barrier integration via completion latch
- Race uses child scope for interrupt-on-close

Closes #392
